mentions.name: Zettelkasten notes app (Mac)
mentions.description: A Mac Zettelkasten notes app focused on UX that combines elements of outliners, wikis, Notational Velocity, and Zettelkasten systems. Notes can live in tree hierarchies or float freely, link to each other via wiki-style text links using unique addresses (no titles or filenames needed), and appear as children of multiple parents. Notebooks end up as many free-floating notes plus small organized trees, navigable through search and filters. Notes sync via iCloud or are stored as plain Markdown files in a folder.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on a Zettelkasten notes app that focuses on getting the UX details right. It takes aspects of Notational Velocity, outliner apps, Zettelkasten, and wikis and combines them into an opinionated Mac app.
